name: sold (mold fork for macOS)
baseline: Apple's default macOS linker called through cc: ld-prime with Xcode 15 or later, ld64 before that
verdict_reason: The author archived sold in November 2024 and now recommends Apple's new linker in Xcode 15 or later instead. Bevy's build guide says it is about the same speed as the default macOS linker. No published numbers show a gain over today's default.
tier_reason: No benchmark numbers were ever published; only the author's and Bevy's statements.
claimed_speedup: No published numbers. The README called it a high-performance macOS linker; Bevy reports it is about the same speed as the default linker
workload: None published: linking on macOS, compared only in prose
platforms: macOS and iOS (Mach-O) plus Linux (ELF, same as mold)
install: Build from source; the repository is archived
one_liner: Archived macOS fork of mold; its author now points users to Apple's Xcode 15+ linker, which is already the default.
how_it_is_fast: sold carried mold's parallel linker design over to Mach-O at a time when Apple's ld64 was slow. Apple has since shipped a new, faster linker (ld-prime) with Xcode 15, which removed the reason for sold to exist.
use_it_when: None for new work: on Xcode 15 or later the default linker is the author's own recommendation
skip_it_when: Any macOS build with Xcode 15 or later
Any project that needs a maintained linker: the repository is archived
caveats: The README never published benchmark numbers
tradeoffs: Unmaintained: no fixes for new Xcode or macOS releases

evidence.quote: is a high-performance linker for macOS. I built it because Apple's ld was too slow at the time, and I wasn't aware that they were developing a new linker. Xcode 15 or later are shipped with Apple's new faster linker. I recommend using that instead.
There is a fork of Mold named Sold that supports macOS, but it is unmaintained and is about the same speed as # the default ld64 linker.
